people.name: Caleb
people.line: Faithful spy, given Hebron as inheritance

translations.web: When she came, she got him to ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey; and Caleb said to her, “What would you like?”
translations.bsb: One day Acsah came to Othniel and urged him to ask her father for a field. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, “What do you desire?”
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when she came to him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted from off her ass; and Caleb said
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when she came unto him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she alighted from off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wouldest thou?
